subject: Critical correction: compiler cannot emit handles from Metal slot indices
body: Your new compute->lowering proposal says pan_res_handle(table, metal_texture_index). This is invalid without an explicit supplied reflection map: native compiler only sees SPIR-V descriptor binding numbers, NOT original Metal slot numbers. Current graphics documented contract is table1/2 indexed by SPIR-V set0 binding N, not Metal slot. Rust WriteSource maps descriptor binding -> SlotRef{stage,class,index}; use that to fill the descriptor table at N. Never assume sampler slot equals texture slot (separate classes; sample texture31 with sampler0 is valid). Samplerless texel fetch/query must use one dedicated internal dummy sampler independent of application slots: requiring app sampler for read() is false semantics. Choose reserved table2 entry with known nearest descriptor and document it with lowering. Please correct this mapping before header freeze.
